title: Dissociation of human oral mucosal tissue for single-cell applications
protocol: Rinse tissue with PBS to remove remaining blood.
Place tissue in the bottom of a petri dish, add 1-2 mL of PBS on top.
Gently agitate tissue in PBS using forceps.
Transfer the tissue with forceps to the top of the petri dish and add 200 μl of tissue culture media to prevent drying.
Mince tissue into pieces smaller than 1 mm in all dimensions using forceps and scissors.
Transfer minced tissue to a gentleMACS C tube containing 10 mL of tissue culture media.
Use a 1000ul pipette tip with the narrow end cut off to transfer minced pieces.
Rinse petri dish with 1 mL tissue culture media and collect the media.
Transfer collected media to the C tube.
Attach the C tube containing tissue upside down to a gentleMACS dissociator.
Run program m_lung_01.01 (8 s at 168 rounds per run, no heat).
Use forceps to transfer any tissue stuck to the plastic blades in the C tube back into the liquid before centrifugation if necessary.
Centrifuge the C tube at 300 × g for 5 min.
Dispose of the supernatant into a 10% bleach solution.
Add 10 mL of digestion buffer to the C tube containing tissue.
Place the tube in an Innova 44 incubator shaker at 37°C and shake at 220 RPM for 45 minutes.
Attach C tube upside down to gentleMACS dissociator and run program m_lung_02.01 (38 s, 2083 rounds per run).
Centrifuge C tube at 300 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend sample in 0.5 mL tissue culture media by pipetting.
Decant contents through a 70 μm cell strainer fitted onto a 50cc tube.
Use the rubber end of a 3 mL syringe plunger to press any remaining tissue through the filter.
Rinse C tube with remaining tissue culture media and pour through filter.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Dispose of supernatant into a 10% bleach solution.
Optional: Perform red blood cell lysis if necessary for downstream application.
Resuspend cells in 5 mL of hypotonic lysis solution and rock the tube back and forth for 60 s.
Add 5 mL of re-equilibration buffer, then top off tube with PBS.
Centrifuge at 5 min at 300 × g.
Repeat lysis steps if RBC are still present.

Resuspend sample in 100 μL of 0.01% BSA in PBS or other resuspension solution according to the single-cell technology protocol and transfer to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube for single-cell library preparation.
Resuspend in 100 μL PBS for flow cytometry, or other buffer depending on downstream application.
Keep sample on wet ice and proceed as quickly as possible with subsequent processing as cells will begin to attach to each other.
Filter the sample immediately before loading the cells into the instrument for the single cell protocol.
Mix 10 μL of cell suspension and 10 μL of AOPI on a small piece of parafilm.
Load 20 μL onto slide and count using Auto 2000.
